titulo_original: The bovine with the curved horns

sinopsis.es: Mezclando fantasía caribeña, realismo mágico y la dolorosa historia de Colombia, The bovine with the curved horns sigue a un niño que busca a su padre desaparecido por un territorio donde el mito y la violencia conviven. Una ópera prima poética y perturbadora, de una belleza y una fuerza emocional notables.
sinopsis.en: Blending Caribbean fantasy, magical realism, and Colombia’s painful history, The bovine with the curved horns follows a boy searching for his missing father through a landscape where myth and violence coexist. A haunting, poetic debut of remarkable beauty and emotional power.
